name: vipertecpro/photo-kit
description: Save images and videos to the photo library with proper permission prompts, compress and resize images, and read or fix EXIF orientation — hand-written Swift and Kotlin behind one PHP API. No third-party libraries.

bridge_functions.name: PhotoKit.Save
bridge_functions.description: Save an image or video file to the photo library (asks for permission first) and report the result via an event

bridge_functions.name: PhotoKit.PermissionStatus
bridge_functions.description: Return the current photo-library permission status without prompting

bridge_functions.name: PhotoKit.RequestPermission
bridge_functions.description: Show the photo-library permission prompt and report the outcome via an event

bridge_functions.name: PhotoKit.Process
bridge_functions.description: Resize, compress and re-encode an image, baking its EXIF orientation into the pixels; returns the new file

bridge_functions.name: PhotoKit.ReadExif
bridge_functions.description: Read the dimensions, EXIF orientation, camera, date and GPS tags of an image

info_plist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Used to save the photos and videos you choose to your photo library.
info_plist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to add the photos and videos you save to an album in your photo library.
